customer_name: Hunan Caixin Financial Holding Group (湖南财信金融控股集团)
business_problem: Hunan Caixin Financial Holding Group wanted to replace siloed, license-by-license systems and offline supply-chain-finance workflows with a shared multi-tenant platform that could launch products faster and add intelligent risk control.
solution_summary: Hunan Caixin Financial Holding Group used Tencent Financial Cloud to replace siloed, license-by-license systems and manual supply-chain-finance processing with a multi-tenant digital platform. Tencent deployed an account-based onboarding model so subsidiaries can quickly activate services, while a configurable product factory lets each licensed entity tailor financing products without waiting for a new standalone build. The first phase supports factoring finance, accounts-receivable pledges, and multi-level circulation; later phases add bill handling, funding connectivity, and broader receivables, inventory, and prepayment financing products. A big-data industrial risk-control platform supplies registration, intelligent verification, and online risk checks, and a private blockchain can extend into consortium chains with core enterprises for shared coordination. The architecture compresses rollout time for new business lines while pairing faster product launch with smarter risk control.
products_used: Big Data Industrial Risk Control Platform

solution_components.name: Multi-tenant Supply Chain Finance Platform
solution_components.role: Hosts shared financing workflows for multiple subsidiaries and licensed business entities.

solution_components.name: Product Factory
solution_components.role: Lets each licensed business configure supply-chain-finance products without building a separate system.

solution_components.name: Big Data Industrial Risk Control Platform
solution_components.role: Supports registration, authentication, intelligent verification, and online risk checks.

solution_components.name: Private Blockchain
solution_components.role: Creates a trusted transaction layer for coordination and traceability across financing workflows.

solution_components.name: Consortium Chain
solution_components.role: Extends the blockchain model to collaboration with core enterprises.

data_flow: Subsidiaries and financing customers open accounts on the shared platform, product definitions are assembled in the product factory, registration and intelligent-verification data pass through the risk-control platform, and blockchain records can be shared with core enterprises through a consortium-chain model.
business_outcome: The program gave Hunan Caixin a faster rollout model for supply-chain-finance products, better digital risk control, and a platform able to support materially higher financing volume.
metrics: System launch time fell from more than 6 months to 7 days.
Single-operation processing time improved from 3-4 days to 1-2 days.
Expected annual lending volume is RMB 3-5 billion.
architecture_clues: Phase one supports factoring finance, accounts-receivable pledges, and multi-level circulation.
Later phases add bill workflows and funding-system connectivity.
Blockchain can be deployed as a private chain and extended into an alliance chain with core enterprises.
evidence_quotes: The group originally used a chimney-style IT model where each licensed company built its own system, and each system took more than six months to build. (original: 原 IT 系统是烟囱式建设模式，一个牌照公司建设一套系统，系统建设用时6个月以上。)

Tencent Financial Cloud deployed a multi-tenant supply-chain-finance solution so subsidiaries could onboard quickly by opening accounts and configure products flexibly in a product factory. (original: 腾讯金融云为客户部署实施一套供应链金融多租户方案...通过开通账户方式快速入驻，并运用平台产品工场，可对各牌照下产品进行灵活配置。)

Tencent also used a big-data industrial risk-control platform for registration, intelligent verification, and online risk checks, and built a private blockchain with the option to co-build a consortium chain with core enterprises. (original: 通过腾讯云大数据产业风控平台，为注册认证、智能核验、风控网查等数据化风控能力提供支持...并为客户搭建区块链私有链，支持与核心企业共建联盟链。)

After implementation, rollout time for the same product fell from six months to seven days, single-operation time improved from 3-4 days to 1-2 days, and annual lending is expected to reach RMB 3-5 billion. (original: 方案实施后，在同产品情况下，各牌照公司系统上线用时从6个月下降到7天，单笔作业用时从3-4天，提升为1-2天；预计全年放款量将在30-50亿。)
